hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); if echo "$FILE" | grep -q '/backend/'; then echo "[RainBird] Restarting backend..."; pkill -f 'uvicorn app.main:app' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; cd /Users/abbas/Documents/dev/RainBird/backend && /Users/abbas/Documents/dev/RainBird/backend/.venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload >> /tmp/rainbird-backend.log 2>&1 & echo "[RainBird] Backend restarted (PID $!)"; elif echo "$FILE" | grep -q '/frontend/'; then echo "[RainBird] Restarting frontend..."; pkill -f 'vite' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; cd /Users/abbas/Documents/dev/RainBird/frontend && npm run dev >> /tmp/rainbird-frontend.log 2>&1 & echo "[RainBird] Frontend restarted (PID $!)"; fi
